name: Trek to Ashenvale
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, my mistress, Raene Wolfrunner, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within Ashenvale. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.

Head south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, a Champion from Darkshore. Selarin has done well to send you here so quickly, adventurer. I wish your trip here wasn't under such dire stress. Perhaps with your help we can improve matters.

I would start my visit by speaking to the other citizens of Astranaar. Some could surely use your aid.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 14 to 22, 6,945 XP in all.

quests.name: How Big a Threat?
quests.objectiveText: Find a corrupt furbolg camp in Darkshore and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.

quests.name: How Big a Threat?
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Blackwood Pathfinders and 5 Windtalkers and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.

quests.name: A Lost Master
quests.objectiveText: Find 5 Fine Moonstalker Pelts and return them to Terenthis in Auberdine.

quests.name: A Lost Master
quests.objectiveText: Find Volcor in Darkshore and give him the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak.

quests.name: Escape Through Stealth
quests.objectiveText: Escape the Furbolg cave and meet Terenthis in Auberdine.

quests.name: Escape Through Force
quests.objectiveText: Protect Volcor until you reach the road, then speak to Terenthis in Auberdine.
